key: SHAYMIN: Sha!
en: SHAYMIN: Sha!
ja: シェイミ: シャ!

key: SHAYMIN: Sha?!
en: SHAYMIN: Sha?!
ja: シェイミ: シャ!?

key: SHAYMIN: Sha.
en: SHAYMIN: Sha.
ja: シェイミ: シャ。

key: SHAYMIN: Sha!!!
en: SHAYMIN: Sha!!!
ja: シェイミ: シャ!!!

key: SHAYMIN: Sha...?
en: SHAYMIN: Sha...?
ja: シェイミ: シャ……?

key: EVE: ...
en: EVE: ...
ja: イヴ: ……

key: Well, this looks promising.
en: Well, this looks promising.
ja: これは、見込みがありそうね。

key: But we won't know for sure until the next step.
en: But we won't know for sure until the next step.
ja: でも、次の段階まで確実なことは分からない。

key: We're going to need five Gracidea flowers next.
en: We're going to need five Gracidea flowers next.
ja: 次はグラシデアのはなが5本必要になるわ。

key: If my research is right, they should spawn in an environment just like this one.
en: If my research is right, they should spawn in an environment just like this one.
ja: あたしの研究が正しければ、まさにこういう環境に咲くはずよ。

key: ...Ah, no.
en: ...Ah, no.
ja: ……ああ、違うわね。

key: Make that four.
en: Make that four.
ja: 4本ってことにしましょう。

key: EVE: Just like this one.
en: EVE: Just like this one.
ja: イヴ: まさにこういう環境にね。

key: Perhaps since these flowers are connected to Shaymin, you'll find them near where the Shaymin first appeared.
en: Perhaps since these flowers are connected to Shaymin, you'll find them near where the Shaymin first appeared.
ja: この花はシェイミとつながりがあるだろうから、シェイミが最初に現れた場所の近くで見つかるかもしれない。

key: EVE: So four more Gracidea flowers then.
en: EVE: So four more Gracidea flowers then.
ja: イヴ: じゃあ、グラシデアのはなをあと4本ね。

key: Could I ask you to go look for them?
en: Could I ask you to go look for them?
ja: 探しに行ってもらえる?

key: I'll keep an eye on the Shaymin here while I keep working.
en: I'll keep an eye on the Shaymin here while I keep working.
ja: あたしは作業を続けながら、ここでシェイミたちを見ておくから。

key: You can ask me if you need some help as well.
en: You can ask me if you need some help as well.
ja: 何か助けが必要なら、聞いてくれてもいいわよ。

key: EVE: You found them?
en: EVE: You found them?
ja: イヴ: 見つけてきてくれたの?

key: \PN handed over the Gracidea flowers.
en: \PN handed over the Gracidea flowers.
ja: \PNはグラシデアのはなを渡した。

key: EVE: ...Perfect.
en: EVE: ...Perfect.
ja: イヴ: ……完璧よ。

key: Using these samples, I should have enough material to synthetically cross-pollinate and produce an entire proper garden in this environment.
en: Using these samples, I should have enough material to synthetically cross-pollinate and produce an entire proper garden in this environment.
ja: このサンプルを使えば、人工的に交配させて、この環境にきちんとした庭園を丸ごと作り出すのに十分な材料がそろうはず。

key: This would normally take a while, but as long as Lumi is in stable condition, there's no need to rush.
en: This would normally take a while, but as long as Lumi is in stable condition, there's no need to rush.
ja: 普段ならしばらく時間がかかるけど、ルミの状態が安定している限り、急ぐ必要はないわ。

key: We can take our time making sure the compounds we need develop properly.
en: We can take our time making sure the compounds we need develop properly.
ja: 必要な化合物がきちんと生成されるように、じっくり時間をかけましょう。

key: ...And she's going to be okay.
en: ...And she's going to be okay.
ja: ……それに、あの子はきっと大丈夫だから。

key: ???: WHAT IN THE FRESH FIRES OF FUCK IS THIS?!
en: ???: WHAT IN THE FRESH FIRES OF FUCK IS THIS?!
ja: ???: これは一体全体、どういうことなのよおおおお!?

key: EVE: ...Pardon?
en: EVE: ...Pardon?
ja: イヴ: ……失礼、何ですって?

key: CRAUDBURRY: What in CARNATIONS are all these GARBAGE plants doing here?!
en: CRAUDBURRY: What in CARNATIONS are all these GARBAGE plants doing here?!
ja: クラウドバリー: このゴミみたいな植物どもは、一体全体何をしてるわけ!?

key: EVE: Uh...
en: EVE: Uh...
ja: イヴ: あの……

key: They grew here?
en: They grew here?
ja: ここで育ったんですけど?

key: Sorry, who are you?
en: Sorry, who are you?
ja: すみません、あなたは?

key: CRAUDBURRY: The name's IGNOSIA CRAUDBURRY, simpleton!
en: CRAUDBURRY: The name's IGNOSIA CRAUDBURRY, simpleton!
ja: クラウドバリー: あたしの名前はイグノシア・クラウドバリーだよ、この能なし!

key: Now wipe that MORONIC look off your SLACK- JAWED face this instant or I'll SLAP you STUPID myself!
en: Now wipe that MORONIC look off your SLACK- JAWED face this instant or I'll SLAP you STUPID myself!
ja: そのマヌケ面、今すぐそのあんぐり開いた口から消しなさい、さもないとあたしが引っぱたいてやるからね!

key: I was just out MINDING MY OWN BUSINESS on what was supposed to be a PEACEFUL WALK, when I noticed that HULKING GATE OF LIGHT sitting in Seacrest's STINKING garden.
en: I was just out MINDING MY OWN BUSINESS on what was supposed to be a PEACEFUL WALK, when I noticed that HULKING GATE OF LIGHT sitting in Seacrest's STINKING garden.
ja: あたしはただ、平和な散歩のつもりで余計な詮索もせず歩いてただけなのに、シークレストのクサい庭に、あのバカでかい光の門が座り込んでるのに気づいたのよ。

key: If I'd known he was growing some kind of OCCULTIST DEVIL PORTAL there, I would've never quit salting his earth with PISS and DUNGWATER!
en: If I'd known he was growing some kind of OCCULTIST DEVIL PORTAL there, I would've never quit salting his earth with PISS and DUNGWATER!
ja: あそこに悪魔崇拝のポータルなんか育ててるって知ってたら、小便と肥やし水であいつの土地に塩をまくのなんて、絶対やめてやらなかったのに!

key: UNAUTHORIZED OCCULTIST DEVIL PORTALS ARE CLEAR VIOLATIONS OF CITY BUILDING CODE!
en: UNAUTHORIZED OCCULTIST DEVIL PORTALS ARE CLEAR VIOLATIONS OF CITY BUILDING CODE!
ja: 無許可の悪魔崇拝ポータルは、明らかな建築基準法違反よ!

key: I should've KNOWN that LILY-LIVERED, good-for- nothing SMARMOSAUR would be out here RAISING RUCKUS again.
en: I should've KNOWN that LILY-LIVERED, good-for- nothing SMARMOSAUR would be out here RAISING RUCKUS again.
ja: あの臆病者で役立たずの猫かぶり野郎が、またここで騒ぎを起こしてるって、分かってて当然だったわね。

key: I bet he's just doing this to get back at me...
en: I bet he's just doing this to get back at me...
ja: どうせあたしへの当てつけでやってるんでしょうよ……

key: EVE: You know the old man?
en: EVE: You know the old man?
ja: イヴ: あの老人と知り合いなんですか?

key: CRAUDBURRY: Oh, I KNEW him all right!
en: CRAUDBURRY: Oh, I KNEW him all right!
ja: クラウドバリー: ええ、そりゃもう、よーく知ってたわよ!

key: Back in the day, I had ol' Seacrest WRAPPED around my FINGER.
en: Back in the day, I had ol' Seacrest WRAPPED around my FINGER.
ja: 昔はね、あのシークレストのじいさんなんて、あたしの言いなりだったんだから。

key: Wrapped around a few other things too, if you catch my drift~
en: Wrapped around a few other things too, if you catch my drift~
ja: 他のいろいろなものにも絡みついてたけどね、分かるでしょ～

key: CRAUDBURRY: But then he RIPPED OUT MY HEART and SHAT ON IT.
en: CRAUDBURRY: But then he RIPPED OUT MY HEART and SHAT ON IT.
ja: クラウドバリー: それなのに、あいつはあたしの心臓を引きちぎって、その上にクソをしたのよ。

key: EVE: Yeah, I'm sorry I asked.
en: EVE: Yeah, I'm sorry I asked.
ja: イヴ: ええ、聞いたことを後悔してます。

key: Look, we're kind of in the middle of something here.
en: Look, we're kind of in the middle of something here.
ja: あの、私たち今ちょっと取り込み中でして。

key: Would you mind stepping aside and letting us finish?
en: Would you mind stepping aside and letting us finish?
ja: よろしければ、脇にどいて済ませてもらえませんか?

key: CRAUDBURRY: Oh, dearie, well why didn't you just say so?
en: CRAUDBURRY: Oh, dearie, well why didn't you just say so?
ja: クラウドバリー: あら、あんた、それを先に言ってくれればよかったのに。

key: Because, as a matter of fact, I WOULD mind!
en: Because, as a matter of fact, I WOULD mind!
ja: だって実際のところ、大いに困るんだからね!

key: If you think ol' Craudburry's just gonna STAND ASIDE and let you practice your ARCANE DEVIL MAGIC, well then, HONEY, you got a BIG SHIT coming!
en: If you think ol' Craudburry's just gonna STAND ASIDE and let you practice your ARCANE DEVIL MAGIC, well then, HONEY, you got a BIG SHIT coming!
ja: このクラウドバリー様が、あんたたちの怪しい悪魔魔法をおとなしく見過ごすとでも思ってんなら、ハニー、とんだクソ食らわせてやるからね!

key: I'm gonna RAZE this entire PUTRID GARDEN back down to the GODDAMNED DEVIL STONE it's grown from!
en: I'm gonna RAZE this entire PUTRID GARDEN back down to the GODDAMNED DEVIL STONE it's grown from!
ja: このおぞましい庭を、そもそも育った忌々しい悪魔の石ころにまで、根こそぎ焼き払ってやる!

key: And once I'm done, I'll TORCH the whole place until the only thing left is the SMOLDERING REMAINS of your HOPES and DEVIL-SUMMONING DREAMS.
en: And once I'm done, I'll TORCH the whole place until the only thing left is the SMOLDERING REMAINS of your HOPES and DEVIL-SUMMONING DREAMS.
ja: それが終わったら、あんたたちの希望と悪魔召喚の夢の、くすぶる残骸しか残らなくなるまで、この場所全部を焼き尽くしてやる。

key: RRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRR...
en: RRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRR...
ja: ンンンンンンンンンン……

key: EVE: ...Right, so...
en: EVE: ...Right, so...
ja: イヴ: ……ええと、それで……

key: So much for taking our time growing things.
en: So much for taking our time growing things.
ja: じっくり時間をかけて育てるどころじゃなくなったわね。

key: It looks like we're going to have to find a way to grow the compounds we need while dealing with this menace.
en: It looks like we're going to have to find a way to grow the compounds we need while dealing with this menace.
ja: どうやら、この脅威に対処しながら、必要な化合物を育てる方法を見つけなきゃならないみたい。

key: You must be familiar with the Flower Garden field effect, right?
en: You must be familiar with the Flower Garden field effect, right?
ja: フラワーガーデンのフィールド効果は、もう知ってるわよね?

key: You'll need to find a way to take her on, and specifically end the battle at the maximum stage of growth.
en: You'll need to find a way to take her on, and specifically end the battle at the maximum stage of growth.
ja: 彼女を倒す方法を見つける必要があるけど、特に成長が最大段階のときにバトルを終わらせなきゃいけない。

key: Just in case you're missing it, I can pass you some data on the Field Effect.
en: Just in case you're missing it, I can pass you some data on the Field Effect.
ja: 念のため、フィールド効果のデータを渡しておくわ。

key: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 33!
en: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 33!
ja: \PNはフィールド効果解析33を手に入れた!

key: Info on Flower Garden Field now available!
en: Info on Flower Garden Field now available!
ja: フラワーガーデンフィールドの情報が閲覧可能になった!

key: EVE: This was not an expected obstacle, but I'm afraid I'll have to count on you once more.
en: EVE: This was not an expected obstacle, but I'm afraid I'll have to count on you once more.
ja: イヴ: 予想外の障害だけど、また頼らせてもらうしかなさそうね。

key: This was not an expected obstacle, but I'm afraid I'll have to count on you once more.
en: This was not an expected obstacle, but I'm afraid I'll have to count on you once more.
ja: 予想外の障害だけど、また頼らせてもらうしかなさそうね。

key: EVE: We're going to need four Gracidea flowers next.
en: EVE: We're going to need four Gracidea flowers next.
ja: イヴ: 次はグラシデアのはなが4本必要になるわ。

key: I suggest looking in places near where you found the Shaymin, since the two are connected.
en: I suggest looking in places near where you found the Shaymin, since the two are connected.
ja: シェイミを見つけた場所の近くを探してみて、あの二つはつながりがあるから。

key: As an additional note, I'm picking up some erratic energy from the larger mushrooms in this place...
en: As an additional note, I'm picking up some erratic energy from the larger mushrooms in this place...
ja: あと付け加えると、ここの大きなキノコから不規則なエネルギーを感じ取ってるの……

key: It seems there are several competing systems?
en: It seems there are several competing systems?
ja: いくつかの競合するシステムがあるみたいね?

key: When one color takes over, the other two become dormant.
en: When one color takes over, the other two become dormant.
ja: 一つの色が優位になると、残りの二つは休眠状態になる。

key: Given that they appear to be affecting the growth around here...
en: Given that they appear to be affecting the growth around here...
ja: このあたりの成長に影響を与えているようだから……

key: Effectively, this means when you 'activate' one fungal system, one type of obstacle will disappear and two others will appear.
en: Effectively, this means when you 'activate' one fungal system, one type of obstacle will disappear and two others will appear.
ja: つまり、一つのキノコ系統を「活性化」すると、一種類の障害物が消えて、代わりに他の二種類が現れるってことね。

key: This appears to be the case for the entire area as a whole.
en: This appears to be the case for the entire area as a whole.
ja: このエリア全体で、同じことが起きているみたい。

key: You may find that the grey mushrooms signify a dead end.
en: You may find that the grey mushrooms signify a dead end.
ja: 灰色のキノコは行き止まりの目印になっているかもしれない。

key: Best of luck, \PN.
en: Best of luck, \PN.
ja: 幸運を祈るわ、\PN。

key: EVE: You'll need to deal with Craudburry, but unfortunately you'll specifically have to end the battle at the maximum stage of flower growth.
en: EVE: You'll need to deal with Craudburry, but unfortunately you'll specifically have to end the battle at the maximum stage of flower growth.
ja: イヴ: クラウドバリーに対処する必要があるけど、残念ながら花の成長が最大段階のときにバトルを終わらせなきゃいけないの。

key: Check your Field Notes for the best ways to grow the field.
en: Check your Field Notes for the best ways to grow the field.
ja: フィールドを育てる最善の方法は、フィールドノートを確認して。

key: This isn't easy, and I am truly sorry that it's come to this.
en: This isn't easy, and I am truly sorry that it's come to this.
ja: 簡単なことじゃないし、こんなことになって本当にごめんなさい。

key: Allow me to heal your team.
en: Allow me to heal your team.
ja: あなたのパーティーを回復させてあげる。

key: EVE: Lumi is counting on you...
en: EVE: Lumi is counting on you...
ja: イヴ: ルミが、あなたを頼りにしてる……

key: LUMI: I remember some of this stuff from when we were stuck together, but it makes more sense now!
en: LUMI: I remember some of this stuff from when we were stuck together, but it makes more sense now!
ja: ルミ: 一緒に閉じ込められてたときのこと、少し覚えてるけど、今の方がずっと理解できる!

key: How did you ever learn all this stuff yourself?
en: How did you ever learn all this stuff yourself?
ja: こういうこと全部、どうやって自分で学んだの?

key: EVE: The same way anyone learns anything, I suppose.
en: EVE: The same way anyone learns anything, I suppose.
ja: イヴ: 誰でも同じ、普通のやり方だと思うわ。

key: Lots of study, practice, time...
en: Lots of study, practice, time...
ja: たくさんの勉強と、練習と、時間……

key: Lots of making mistakes.
en: Lots of making mistakes.
ja: たくさんの失敗も。

key: And a lot of reason to learn it properly as fast as possible.
en: And a lot of reason to learn it properly as fast as possible.
ja: それと、できるだけ早く、ちゃんと学ぶ理由もたくさんあった。

key: CRAUDBURRY: FIRE, SCOURGE and DUNGWATER!
en: CRAUDBURRY: FIRE, SCOURGE and DUNGWATER!
ja: クラウドバリー: 火に、疫病に、肥やし水よ!

key: I'll BURN this DEVIL HOUSE to OBLIVION and back again no matter how many times it takes!!!
en: I'll BURN this DEVIL HOUSE to OBLIVION and back again no matter how many times it takes!!!
ja: 何度かかろうと、この悪魔の館を、消え去るまで焼き尽くしてやる!!!

key: MARK MY WORDS, DEVILS, THE EARTH SHALL BECOME NAUGHT BUT SALT AND ASH BEFORE ME!
en: MARK MY WORDS, DEVILS, THE EARTH SHALL BECOME NAUGHT BUT SALT AND ASH BEFORE ME!
ja: よく聞きなさい、悪魔ども、この大地はあたしの前で塩と灰以外の何物でもなくなる運命よ!

key: EVE: There! We've got the level of growth we needed!
en: EVE: There! We've got the level of growth we needed!
ja: イヴ: よし! 必要な成長段階に達したわ!

key: CRAUDBURRY: Rrrrrrrr...
en: CRAUDBURRY: Rrrrrrrr...
ja: クラウドバリー: ンンンンン……

key: RRRRRRRRRRR...
en: RRRRRRRRRRR...
ja: ンンンンンンンンン……

key: RRRRRRRRRRRRRRRR...
en: RRRRRRRRRRRRRRRR...
ja: ンンンンンンンンンンンンン……

key: EVE: Did she just...
en: EVE: Did she just...
ja: イヴ: 今、まさか……

key: EVE: ...No, on second thought, I'm not going to ask any more questions about anything that just transpired.
en: EVE: ...No, on second thought, I'm not going to ask any more questions about anything that just transpired.
ja: イヴ: ……いえ、考え直したわ、今起きたことについては、これ以上何も聞かないことにする。

key: LUMI: Eve?!
en: LUMI: Eve?!
ja: ルミ: お姉ちゃん!?

key: LUMI: Eve, are you okay?!
en: LUMI: Eve, are you okay?!
ja: ルミ: お姉ちゃん、大丈夫!?

key: I heard that noise-- what happened?!
en: I heard that noise-- what happened?!
ja: あの音が聞こえたんだけど――何があったの!?

key: EVE: No, everything's okay; there's no need for concern.
en: EVE: No, everything's okay; there's no need for concern.
ja: イヴ: いいえ、全部大丈夫よ、心配ないわ。

key: ...Weren't you going to be waiting elsewhere?
en: ...Weren't you going to be waiting elsewhere?
ja: ……別の場所で待ってるんじゃなかったの?

key: LUMI: ...I was worried, okay?
en: LUMI: ...I was worried, okay?
ja: ルミ: ……心配だったの、いいでしょ?

key: Oh! Hi there, cuties!
en: Oh! Hi there, cuties!
ja: あ! こんにちは、可愛い子たち!

key: SHAYMIN: Shami!
en: SHAYMIN: Shami!
ja: シェイミ: シャミ!

key: LUMI: ...They're really okay?
en: LUMI: ...They're really okay?
ja: ルミ: ……この子たち、本当に無事なの?

key: EVE: No mutations, no restraints, no harm.
en: EVE: No mutations, no restraints, no harm.
ja: イヴ: 変異なし、拘束なし、危害なし。

key: That Flora girl had some decent theories.
en: That Flora girl had some decent theories.
ja: あのフローラって子、なかなかいい理論を持ってたわ。

key: I'm sure she has a bright future ahead of her.
en: I'm sure she has a bright future ahead of her.
ja: きっと将来有望よ。

key: Though personally, I'm surprised the Shaymin haven't just wandered off.
en: Though personally, I'm surprised the Shaymin haven't just wandered off.
ja: でも個人的には、このシェイミたちがふらっと逃げていかなかったのが意外だけど。

key: LUMI: Maybe they know we need their help!
en: LUMI: Maybe they know we need their help!
ja: ルミ: きっと、あたしたちが助けを必要としてるって分かってるんだよ!

key: Thank you all for your support!
en: Thank you all for your support!
ja: みんな、協力してくれてありがとう!

key: SHAYMIN: Mimi!!!
en: SHAYMIN: Mimi!!!
ja: シェイミ: ミミ!!!

key: EVE: So, you seem... better.
en: EVE: So, you seem... better.
ja: イヴ: それで、あなた……調子はよくなったみたいね。

key: LUMI: I'm sorry for how I reacted before.
en: LUMI: I'm sorry for how I reacted before.
ja: ルミ: さっきはあんな反応しちゃって、ごめんね。

key: I was thinking about it and I realized that maybe the thing I'm most uncomfortable with is having you do all the work for me.
en: I was thinking about it and I realized that maybe the thing I'm most uncomfortable with is having you do all the work for me.
ja: ちゃんと考えてみたら、あたしが一番嫌だったのは、お姉ちゃんに全部やってもらうことだったんだって気づいたの。

key: I know what happens to me affects you too, but this is my body.
en: I know what happens to me affects you too, but this is my body.
ja: あたしに起きることが、お姉ちゃんにも影響するのは分かってる。でも、これはあたしの体だから。

key: And, I don't want to have to just sit around and be saved by you all the time!
en: And, I don't want to have to just sit around and be saved by you all the time!
ja: それに、いつもただ座って、お姉ちゃんに助けられてるだけでいたくない!

key: So!
en: So!
ja: だから!

key: I've decided that I'm not going to accept any cure you make!
en: I've decided that I'm not going to accept any cure you make!
ja: お姉ちゃんが作った治療法は、受け取らないことにする!

key: EVE: Um, what--
en: EVE: Um, what--
ja: イヴ: え、何――

key: LUMI: I'm going to make it myself!
en: LUMI: I'm going to make it myself!
ja: ルミ: 自分で作るから!

key: EVE: ...Ah.
en: EVE: ...Ah.
ja: イヴ: ……あ。

key: LUMI: You can show me how and you can help,
en: LUMI: You can show me how and you can help,
ja: ルミ: やり方は教えてくれていいし、手伝ってくれてもいい、

key: But I'm going to be the one to actually make it.
